player_prompt.intro:
Kcemm iseqdac {player_id} g umukris n Indian Poker.
- Uɣirsis 52 n tɣuriwin; tɣuri n umsɣazi ka tẓṛat.
- Iɣtis {ante} n tɣuriwin n uɣris kraygat talɣa, {max_rounds} n talɣa(t) kullut.
- Imenyuten imseɣten: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X d azwil azayku ≤ uṭṭun n tɣuriwin inu.)
- Tɣuri tinzɣarin tisɣnin taf tɣuriwin n uɣris g ussudu.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Sekkes aya ad yefrek yiwet n tuccfa tazrayt, s tetturar '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', neɣ '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Ur tzemreḍ ara ad [check] - tllaḍ ṣṣerḥ ɣef wudm.
invalid_move.amount_min: ⵉⵇⵇⴰⵏ ⴷ ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⵡⴰⵜⵉⴳ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵙⴰⵔⵓ/ⵜⴰⵙⴳⵎⵉ ≥ 1.
invalid_move.cannot_bet: Ur tzemreḍ ara ad [bet] - ilaq ad [call] / [raise] / [fold].
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵎⴰ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵙⵙⴰⵖ; ⵥⴹⴰⵕⴷ [check] ⴳ ⵓⴱⴰⵔⴰⵣ.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: ⵙⵎⵔⴰⵙ [bet X] ⴰⴼⴰⴷ ⴰⴷ ⵜⴱⵉⴷⴷ; ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵡⴰⵜⵉⴳ ⵉ ⵓⵙⴽⵛⵎ.
invalid_move.insufficient: ⵓⵔ ⵍⵍⵉⵏ ⵉⴼⵔⴷⵉⵙⵏ ⵉⵅⴰⵜⴰⵔⵏ ⴳ ⵜⵡⵓⵔⵉ ⴰⴷ.
